河流地貌的发育 · 3D 互动课件: Development of River Landforms · Interactive 3D Lesson
河谷加深、拓宽、延长：V 形 → 槽形: Valleys deepen, widen and lengthen: V-shaped → trough-shaped
长江镇江段的岸线为什么持续向北推移？: Why does the bank of the Yangtze at Zhenjiang keep moving north?
山区落差大 → 流速快 → 向下侵蚀为主: Steep mountain gradient → fast flow → mainly downcutting
落差减小 → 向两岸侵蚀加强 → 河谷拓宽: Gradient drops → lateral erosion strengthens → valley widens
凹岸侵蚀、凸岸堆积 → 河道更弯: Concave bank erodes, convex bank deposits → the channel bends more
流速减慢 → 搬运能力减弱 → 三种冲积平原: Flow slows → carrying capacity falls → three kinds of alluvial plain
落差大、流速快，以向下侵蚀为主，横剖面呈 V 形: Steep gradient and fast flow, mainly downcutting; V-shaped cross-section
出山口坡度骤减、流速减慢，粗颗粒就地堆积成扇: At the mountain mouth the slope drops sharply and the flow slows; coarse grains are dropped on the spot as a fan
河道弯曲，凹岸侵蚀、凸岸堆积，枯水露出成河漫滩: The channel bends, the concave bank erodes and the convex bank deposits; at low water it shows as a floodplain
入海处水下坡度平缓、流速减慢，泥沙在河口前方堆积并向海扩展: Where it enters the sea the underwater slope is gentle and the flow slows; sediment piles up in front of the mouth and spreads seaward
一条河从山里流到海，一路上留下了什么？: A river runs from the mountains to the sea. What does it leave along the way?
拖动视角，把整块沙盘转一圈: Drag the view and turn the whole sand table around
四个部位的名牌依次亮；等高线显示山地最高、河口最低；冲积平原上有 3 处村镇: The four section labels light up in turn; contours show the mountains highest and the mouth lowest; there are 3 towns on the alluvial plains
整块沙盘是一条 40 km 长的河，从山地一直流到海。: The whole sand table is a 40 km river running from the mountains to the sea.
四个部位从上游到下游排开：山区河谷 → 山前冲积扇 → 曲流与河漫滩 → 河口三: Four sections line up from upstream to downstream: mountain valley → piedmont alluvial fan → meanders and floodplain → river-mouth delta.
村镇都落在冲积平原上、洪水淹不到的地方（教材 p.37）。: The towns all sit on alluvial plains, where floods don't reach (textbook p. 37).
去掉这一刻：不知道三种冲积平原各在哪一段，后面三步会把顺序记反。: Without this moment: you don't know where each of the three alluvial plains is, and the next three steps get the order wrong.
考点：三种冲积平原的位置与形成条件。: Exam point: location and formation conditions of the three alluvial plains.
河流是塑造地表形态的重要外力：它一路侵蚀、搬运、堆积，把河谷加深、拓宽、延长，还: Rivers are an important external force shaping the land surface: along their course they erode, transport and deposit, deepening, widening and lengthening valleys, and building three kinds of alluvial plain at the mountain front, in the middle and lower reaches, and at the mouth.
为什么山里的河谷又深又窄，还是个 V 形？: Why are mountain valleys deep, narrow and V-shaped?
把演化阶段拖回幼年期，看山区河谷的流速和它能搬动多大的石头: Drag the evolution stage back to youth and look at the flow speed in the mountain valley and how big a stone it can move
流速 3.38 m/s；能搬动 152.0 mm 的卵石；冲淤判据＝「以向下侵蚀: Flow 3.38 m/s; can move 152.0 mm pebbles; erosion/deposition verdict = "mainly downcutting"
落差大 + 流速快 → 下蚀、溯源侵蚀: Steep gradient + fast flow → downcutting, headward erosion
幼年期纵剖面最陡（落差 145 m）: In youth the long profile is steepest (drop 145 m)
V 形：深而窄、谷壁陡峭: V-shaped: deep and narrow, steep valley walls
幼年期河道纵剖面最陡，河床落差 145 m（示意）。: In youth the long profile is steepest, with a channel drop of 145 m (illustrative).
流速 3.38 m/s 时能搬动 152.0 mm 的卵石——水流是有力的。: At 3.38 m/s the flow can move 152.0 mm pebbles: the water is powerful.
「能搬动多大的颗粒」比单看流速更直观地说明搬运能力。: "How big a grain it can move" shows carrying capacity more directly than flow speed alone.
去掉这一步：会把 V 形谷当成「河水冲出来的浅沟」，不知道它以下蚀为主、也不知道: Without this step: you take a V-shaped valley for "a shallow ditch the water washed out", not knowing it is mainly downcutting or that the valley extends upstream.
考点：V 形谷 = 落差大、流速快 → 向下和向源头侵蚀为主。: Exam point: V-shaped valley = steep gradient, fast flow → mainly downward and headward erosion.
幼年期落差大、流速快、能量集中，侵蚀以向下和向源头为主，河谷不断加深、延长，所以: In youth the gradient is steep, the flow fast and the energy concentrated; erosion is mainly downward and headward, so the valley keeps deepening and lengthening, making it deep and narrow with steep walls and a V-shaped cross-section (on the block the valley head retreats upstream with each stage: that is headward erosion).
河谷后来怎样变宽变浅？: How does the valley later become wider and shallower?
把演化阶段从幼年期拖到老年期，看河谷切块的前切面: Drag the evolution stage from youth to old age and look at the front face of the valley block
宽深比 10.0 → 60.0 → 200.0；剖面由窄深的 V 形变成宽而浅的: Width-to-depth ratio 10.0 → 60.0 → 200.0; the profile changes from a narrow, deep V to a wide, shallow trough
宽深比 = 谷宽 ÷ 谷深：10 → 60 → 200: Width-to-depth ratio = valley width ÷ valley depth: 10 → 60 → 200
切块取自山区河谷，对照教材图 2.27 a/b/c: Block taken from the mountain valley, compare textbook Fig. 2.27 a/b/c
灰虚线：其余阶段的轮廓: Grey dashed: outlines of the other stages
切面下部是岩层: Rock layers in the lower part of the face
宽深比是「谷宽 ÷ 谷深」：10 是 V 形谷，200 是宽而浅的槽形。: The width-to-depth ratio is "valley width ÷ valley depth": 10 is a V-shaped valley, 200 a wide, shallow trough.
剖面里能看到谷壁由陡变缓、谷底由窄槽变成宽平底；灰色虚线是其余阶段的轮廓，可直接: In the profile the valley walls go from steep to gentle and the floor from a narrow slot to a wide flat bottom; the grey dashed lines are the outlines of the other stages for direct comparison.
剖面同时露出地层，说明河谷是「切」进原来地面的。: The profile also exposes the strata, showing the valley was "cut" into the original ground.
去掉这一步：只知道河谷「变宽」，说不出宽深比这个可量的判据，也不会把 V 形和槽: Without this step: you only know the valley "gets wider", can't name the measurable criterion of the width-to-depth ratio, and can't match V and trough shapes.
考点：河谷横剖面由 V 形向槽形演化（本章要点 8）。: Exam point: valley cross-sections evolve from V-shaped to trough-shaped (chapter key point 8).
落差减小以后，向下侵蚀减弱、向两岸侵蚀加强，河谷不断拓宽；经漫长过程，横剖面变成: Once the gradient drops, downcutting weakens and lateral erosion strengthens, so the valley keeps widening; over a long time the cross-section becomes a wide, shallow trough.
水一出山，为什么先把大石头放下？: Once the water leaves the mountains, why does it drop the big stones first?
把观察河段从山区拖到出山口，看流速和能搬动的最大粒径: Drag the observed reach from the mountains to the mountain mouth and look at the flow speed and the largest grain it can move
流速 2.90 → 1.45 m/s；能搬动的最大粒径 106.3 → 25.7: Flow 2.90 → 1.45 m/s; largest movable grain 106.3 → 25.7 mm; erosion/deposition verdict = "carrying capacity falls · deposition begins"
出山口：坡度骤减 → 流速减慢 → 粗颗粒卸下: Mountain mouth: slope drops sharply → flow slows → coarse grains are dropped
扇顶 63.3 mm 比扇缘 25.7 mm 粗: Fan apex 63.3 mm is coarser than fan edge 25.7 mm
搬不动才堆: It piles up only when it can't be carried
判据是「本段搬得动的最大粒径明显小于上游」——上游送来的粗颗粒在这里搬不动了。: The criterion is "the largest grain this reach can move is clearly smaller than upstream": the coarse grains brought from upstream can't be carried further here.
扇顶（63.3 mm）比扇缘（25.7 mm）粗，说明粗颗粒先落地。: The fan apex (63.3 mm) is coarser than the fan edge (25.7 mm), so coarse grains settle first.
冲积扇是扇状堆积体，不是河谷。: An alluvial fan is a fan-shaped deposit, not a valley.
去掉这一步：会以为「流速小就堆」，说不出「搬不动才堆」这个因果。: Without this step: you think "slow flow means deposition" and can't state the cause "it piles up when it can't be carried".
考点：冲积扇的形成条件（出山口、坡度骤减、流速减慢）。: Exam point: formation conditions of an alluvial fan (mountain mouth, sharp drop in slope, slower flow).
河流流出山区进入平原，地势趋于平缓、河道开阔、流速减慢，搬运的物质逐渐在山前沉积: When a river leaves the mountains for the plain, the land flattens, the channel opens out and the flow slows; the material it carries gradually settles at the mountain front as a fan; as the fans of several rivers grow and merge they form a broad piedmont alluvial plain.
河道弯了以后，冲和淤各在哪一岸？: Once the channel bends, which bank erodes and which fills?
把演化阶段从幼年期拖回壮年期，让河道弯起来: Drag the evolution stage from youth back to maturity and let the channel bend
弯道附加系数 0.313；凹岸流速 1.09 m/s、凸岸 0.57 m/s；冲: Bend factor 0.313; concave bank flow 1.09 m/s, convex bank 0.57 m/s; erosion/deposition verdict = "concave bank erodes · convex bank deposits"
凹岸（外侧）v 1.09 · 凸岸（内侧）v 0.57 m/s: Concave (outer) bank v 1.09 · convex (inner) bank v 0.57 m/s
弯道外侧流速快 → 侵蚀；内侧流速慢 → 堆积: Fast flow on the outside of a bend → erosion; slow flow on the inside → deposition
凹岸＝弯道外侧: Concave bank = outside of the bend
凸岸＝弯道内侧: Convex bank = inside of the bend
绿：堆积前伸 · 流速 0.57: Green: built out by deposition · flow 0.57
凹岸是弯道外侧，凸岸是弯道内侧，不是「左岸右岸」。: The concave bank is the outside of the bend and the convex bank the inside; not "left bank, right bank".
两岸流速差 1.09 : 0.57 就是冲淤差异的来源。: The flow difference of 1.09 : 0.57 between the banks is the source of the different erosion and deposition.
长江镇江段南岸是凸岸（堆）、北岸是凹岸（冲），所以岸线向北推移。: At Zhenjiang the south bank of the Yangtze is convex (deposits) and the north bank concave (erodes), so the bank moves north.
去掉这一步：只会背「凹岸侵蚀凸岸堆积」，一遇到真实河流就分不清哪一岸是凹岸。: Without this step: you can only recite "concave erodes, convex deposits", and can't tell which bank is concave on a real river.
考点：凹岸侵蚀、凸岸堆积与岸线推移方向。: Exam point: concave-bank erosion, convex-bank deposition and the direction the bank moves.
河道弯曲后，凹岸（弯道外侧）水流快、受冲刷侵蚀、岸线后退；凸岸（弯道内侧）水流慢: Once the channel bends, the concave bank (outside) has fast flow, is scoured and retreats; the convex bank (inside) has slow flow, collects sediment and builds out; the channel bends more and the valley widens.
洪水退去以后，河边留下什么？: What is left by the river after a flood recedes?
打开汛期，看水面漫上河漫滩: Turn on the flood season and watch the water spread over the floodplain
流速 0.83 → 1.05 m/s；水面漫上河漫滩；冲淤判据仍是「凹岸侵蚀 ·: Flow 0.83 → 1.05 m/s; water spreads over the floodplain; verdict still "concave bank erodes · convex bank deposits"
凸岸堆积 → 枯水露出 → 洪水再淤: Convex bank deposits → exposed at low water → silted again by floods
河漫滩平原是冲积平原的主体: Floodplains make up most of the alluvial plain
沿河呈带状分布: Distributed in bands along the river
河漫滩是「凸岸堆积体露出水面」的结果，不是流水冲出来的。: A floodplain is "a convex-bank deposit exposed above the water", not something washed out by flowing water.
汛期来水量 × 1.8，流速 1.05 m/s、能搬动 11.9 mm，比平水期: In the flood season inflow is × 1.8, flow 1.05 m/s and it can move 11.9 mm, stronger than at normal water, but the floodplain is still mainly depositing.
河漫滩平原是冲积平原的主体，沿河呈带状分布。: Floodplains make up most of the alluvial plain and lie in bands along the river.
去掉这一步：会把河漫滩当成河道的一部分，不知道它是一次次洪水淤出来的。: Without this step: you treat the floodplain as part of the channel, not knowing it was built up flood after flood.
考点：河漫滩与河漫滩平原的形成（凸岸堆积 → 枯水露出 → 洪水再淤）。: Exam point: formation of floodplains and floodplain plains (convex-bank deposition → exposed at low water → silted again by floods).
凸岸堆积成水下堆积体，升高扩大后在枯水季节露出水面成为河漫滩；洪水季节被淹没继续: The convex bank builds an underwater deposit; as it rises and grows it shows above the water at low water as a floodplain; in floods it is submerged and receives more sediment; many abandoned floodplains joined together make a broad floodplain plain.
河口为什么会长出一块三角洲？: Why does a delta grow at the river mouth?
把演化阶段推到老年期，让三角洲前缘向海推进: Push the evolution stage to old age and let the delta front advance into the sea
河口流速 0.45 → 0.38 m/s；能搬动的最大粒径 2.4 → 1.6: Mouth flow 0.45 → 0.38 m/s; largest movable grain 2.4 → 1.6 mm; delta front advances from 1.8 km to 3.6 km
入海处坡度平缓 → 流速减慢 → 泥沙在河口前方堆积: Gentle slope where it enters the sea → slower flow → sediment piles up in front of the mouth
三角洲的条件是「入海处水下坡度平缓」加「流速减慢」，不是「泥沙多」就够。: A delta needs "a gentle underwater slope where it enters the sea" plus "slower flow"; "lots of sediment" alone is not enough.
河口只搬得动 1.6 mm 的砂，粗颗粒早在中上游卸完了。: At the mouth it can only move 1.6 mm sand; the coarse grains were dropped long before in the middle and upper reaches.
前缘 1.8 → 3.6 km，是可以量的「向海扩展」。: Front 1.8 → 3.6 km is a measurable "spread toward the sea".
去掉这一步：会把三角洲说成「河流冲出来的」，其实是一层层堆出来的。: Without this step: you describe a delta as "washed out by the river" when it is actually built up layer by layer.
考点：三角洲的形成条件与向海扩展。: Exam point: formation conditions of a delta and its seaward spread.
挟带泥沙的河流进入海洋时，入海处水下坡度平缓、流速减慢，泥沙在河口前方沉积成近似: When a sediment-laden river enters the sea, the underwater slope is gentle and the flow slows, so the sediment settles in front of the mouth as a roughly triangular deposit; as sediment builds up it spreads seaward and becomes a delta plain.
汛期里怎样让曲流段搬不动 10 mm 的砾石？: In the flood season, how do you make the meander reach unable to move 10 mm gravel?
调整演化阶段或上游来水量，让能搬动的最大粒径降到 10 mm 以下并保持 15: Adjust the evolution stage or the upstream inflow so the largest movable grain falls below 10 mm, and hold for 15 s
开局 8.3 mm；第 5 s 汛期来了 → 11.9 mm（超标）；把阶段推到: Starts at 8.3 mm; at 5 s the flood season arrives → 11.9 mm (over the limit); push the stage to old age → 8.1 mm, or set the inflow to 100 m³/s → 7.8 mm
汛期里 D_max < 10 mm: D_max < 10 mm in the flood season
第 5 s 自动放汛期: Flood season starts automatically at 5 s
两条因果路线都算达标: Either chain of causes counts as passing
汛期把来水量抬到 1.8 倍，搬运能力跟着涨。: The flood season raises the inflow to 1.8 times, and carrying capacity rises with it.
老年期纵剖面最平缓（落差 51 m），同一河段的流速与搬运能力都最弱。: In old age the long profile is gentlest (drop 51 m), so the same reach has the weakest flow and carrying capacity.
调小来水量是另一条同样成立的路——两条都指向「流速减慢 → 搬运能力减弱」。: Reducing the inflow is another equally valid route; both lead to "slower flow → lower carrying capacity".
去掉这一步：只会背「流速慢就沉积」，不会在条件变化后用两个读数一起判断。: Without this step: you can only recite "slow flow deposits" and can't judge from two readings together when conditions change.
考核：在汛期里让曲流段搬不动 10 mm 的砾石（保持 15 s）。: Assessment: in the flood season, make the meander reach unable to move 10 mm gravel (hold for 15 s).
同一河段能搬动的最大粒径只由流速决定：纵剖面变缓、来水量变小，都会让它降下来。: The largest grain a reach can move depends only on the flow speed: a gentler long profile or a smaller inflow both bring it down.
河谷切块（水平 1 格 = 1 km，垂直放大 ×10）: Valley block (1 grid = 1 km horizontally, vertical exaggeration ×10)
前切面：谷宽 / 谷深与各阶段轮廓: Front face: valley width / depth and outlines of each stage
凹岸侵蚀 · 凸岸堆积: Concave bank erodes · convex bank deposits
村镇分布在洪水淹不到的地方: Towns lie where floods don't reach
在汛期里让曲流段搬不动 10 mm 的砾石: In the flood season, make the meander reach unable to move 10 mm gravel
汛期来了：上游来水量涨到 1.8 倍: The flood season arrives: upstream inflow rises to 1.8 times
试试把演化阶段推到老年期，或者把上游来水量调小: Try pushing the evolution stage to old age, or turning down the upstream inflow
山区河谷横剖面呈 V 形，主要因为: A mountain valley has a V-shaped cross-section mainly because of
幼年期落差大、流速快，侵蚀以向下和向源头为主，河谷加深、延长，横剖面呈 V 形（: In youth the gradient is steep and the flow fast; erosion is mainly downward and headward, so the valley deepens and lengthens with a V-shaped cross-section (textbook p. 33).
长江镇江段南岸为凸岸、北岸为凹岸，岸线因此: At Zhenjiang the south bank of the Yangtze is convex and the north bank concave, so the bank
凹岸侵蚀后退、凸岸堆积前伸：北岸是凹岸，所以岸线持续向北推移（教材 p.33）。: The concave bank erodes back and the convex bank builds out: the north bank is concave, so the bank keeps moving north (textbook p. 33).
河流中下游: in the middle and lower reaches
河流流出山区进入平原，坡度骤减、流速减慢，物质在山前沉积成扇状（教材 p.34–: When a river leaves the mountains for the plain, the slope drops sharply and the flow slows, and material settles as a fan at the mountain front (textbook pp. 34–35).
